selection.decision: No single modern fictional artwork in this pass proves a living painted cannibal rider on a living horse in bone barding while visibly holding or using a sling with a stone pouch. No candidate is approved for Meshy, ImageGen, Blender, processing, DDS conversion, or runtime wiring.
selection.required_gate: one single artwork showing a living painted cannibal rider on a living horse in bone barding, visibly using or holding a sling with a stone pouch, with no spear, lance, or sword substituting the sling

candidates.title: Horned Warrior on Pale Steed
candidates.date_or_era_fit: Modern fictional fantasy illustration; date not established by the recovered profile capture.
candidates.rights: Copyrighted personal artwork; no public reuse license was found. Reference-only comparison under user authorization; not a permission grant.
candidates.noai_evidence: The recovered jina.ai page capture contains no usable NoAI or license statement.
candidates.uncertainty: The page capture is a small service response rather than the original social page, so attribution is based on the account name and search result context.
gate_failure: The living painted rider visibly carries two long spears, not a sling.
No sling or stone pouch is visible.
The horse has dangling severed-arm decorations rather than readable bone barding.
